title: Verify an AGB’s floor location using the node code (cell code) QR physical number
summary: Use the node code (cell code) reference and the floor QR code’s physical number to verify where an AGB is located on the floor, and to direct someone to the correct location.
when_to_use: When someone needs confirmation of an AGB’s floor location and you have (or can obtain) the node code/cell code value for that AGB location.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Visually locate the correct floor QR code, read its physical number, and compare it to the provided node code/cell code for the AGB location.
access_or_tools_needed: Visual access to the floor QR code
Node code/cell code value provided for the AGB location

system_preconditions: You have the node code (cell code) value that is claimed to correspond to the AGB’s location.

visual_references.description: Frame showing the statement that node code (cell code) matches what’s on the floor and that the floor QR code has a physical number used to verify an AGB’s location.

steps.title: Locate the floor QR code at the relevant cell/location area
steps.purpose: Find the physical location marker on the floor so you can read the QR code’s physical number for comparison.
steps.instruction: Go to the relevant cell/location area on the floor and visually locate the floor QR code.
steps.expected_result: You can see the floor QR code at the relevant cell/location area.
steps.healthy_condition: The floor QR code is clearly visible at the intended cell/location area.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the floor QR code at the claimed location area.

actions.label: Find floor QR code
actions.exact_action: Locate the floor QR code at the relevant cell/location area.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “This will match what's on the floor. So if you look at the floor, that QR code has a physical number on it.”

steps.title: Read the physical number on the floor QR code
steps.purpose: Capture the physical number printed on the floor QR code so it can be compared to the node code/cell code.
steps.instruction: Read the physical number shown on the floor QR code.
steps.expected_result: You have the physical number from the floor QR code.
steps.healthy_condition: The physical number on the QR code is legible and recorded correctly.
steps.failure_condition: The physical number is not legible or cannot be read accurately.

actions.label: Read QR physical number
actions.exact_action: Read the physical number on the floor QR code.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “that QR code has a physical number on it”

steps.title: Compare the floor QR physical number to the node code (cell code) for the AGB location
steps.purpose: Verify that the claimed AGB location matches the physical floor marker.
steps.instruction: Compare the physical number you read from the floor QR code to the node code (cell code) value provided for the AGB location.
steps.expected_result: The node code (cell code) matches the physical number on the floor QR code.
steps.healthy_condition: The node code/cell code value corresponds to the same physical number printed on the floor QR code.
steps.failure_condition: The node code/cell code value does not match the physical number on the floor QR code.

actions.label: Compare values
actions.exact_action: Compare that physical number to the node code/cell code provided for the AGB location.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the node code/cell code does not match the physical number on the floor QR code, do not assume the AGB is at the stated location; escalate for clarification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript near this frame: “This will match what's on the floor… that QR code has a physical number on it… you can verify it… this is where the AGB's at.”

steps.title: Use the verified node code/cell code and floor QR physical number to direct others to the correct location
steps.purpose: Communicate the verified location to others so they can go to the correct floor area.
steps.instruction: If the values match, tell others the verified location using the node code/cell code and the floor QR physical number reference (i.e., the location that the match confirms).
steps.expected_result: You can confidently communicate the correct location to others based on the match between node code/cell code and the floor QR physical number.
steps.healthy_condition: Your communicated location aligns with the verified match you observed.
steps.failure_condition: You communicate a location without verifying the match (or after a mismatch).

actions.label: Direct to verified location
actions.exact_action: Use the node code and the floor QR physical number to verify the location and direct someone to the correct location.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the node code/cell code does not match the physical number on the floor QR code, do not assume the AGB is at the stated location; escalate for clarification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “if someone tells you this AGB's on this location, you can verify it… or you can look at this node code and or you even it can tell someone, hey, go to this location. This is where the AGB's at”

success_criteria: The node code (cell code) matches the physical number on the floor QR code for the claimed AGB location.
healthy_conditions: Floor QR code physical number is readable and matches the provided node code/cell code.
failure_conditions: Node code/cell code does not match the floor QR physical number; location cannot be verified.
escalation_guidance: If the node code/cell code does not match the physical number on the floor QR code, do not assume the AGB is at the stated location; escalate for clarification.
